profile.name: USB-CAN总线适配器
profile.description: 这是一种通过 USB 连接计算机、并接入 CAN 总线网络的硬件适配器，用于在实验室中与控制器、传感器、执行器或其他采用 CAN 通信的设备进行报文收发、联机调试和系统集成测试。
profile.description_en: This is a hardware adapter that connects a computer to a CAN bus network over USB. In laboratory use, it is used to send and receive CAN messages, debug communication, and integrate or test controllers, sensors, actuators, and other CAN-based equipment.

This is a hardware adapter that connects a computer to a CAN bus network over USB. In laboratory use, it is used to send and receive CAN messages, debug communication, and integrate or test controllers, sensors, actuators, and other CAN-based equipment.
